reader_images: All source image bytes embedded in index.html; no image network or sibling-folder requests needed.

semantics.robot_id: YEAR-TEAM; team number alone is ambiguous
semantics.image_paths: Relative to corpus root, including inside packets; never relative to the packet file
semantics.units: Published strings retain source units and ratio order. No automatic physical normalization.
semantics.version_groups: Publication labels, not audited competition intervals. Null dates mean unknown.
semantics.evidence: Types describe attribution, not calibrated probabilities. Analyst inference is not a team statement. Proposed tests are not performed.
semantics.search_ranking: FTS5 bm25 lexical relevance only; not confidence, causation, robot quality or EPA.
semantics.field_sourcing: Technical notes have source/page locators; dossier synopsis fields retain coarser source bundles.
semantics.manuals: Source links and narrative references are retained; rule-version completeness and field CAD coverage are not certified. Verify governing rules for a new design.
semantics.scope: 128 provisional dossiers: original 125 plus supplemental 2022/2023/2026 Team 604 entries. 27 robot-years retain earlier reviewed technical-publication coverage; the other focused studies and new 604 primary-source studies have their own explicit scopes. Zero exhaustive version certifications. 35 available full-caption reviews; nine recovered transcripts await content review. No visual Einstein audit is claimed or required by the user. Full channel inventory remains unverified.

required_workflow: Read AGENTS.md and the full game chapter for the target year.
Set role, event stage, partner assumptions and team resources.

For each new manual analysis, material rules revision or new/revised robot design brief, follow docs/TASK_LIST_PROTOCOL.md and deliver a filled copy of the one-sheet 1833 task template before the final architecture recommendation. Preserve human decisions separately; no group tabs.
Search explicit year/function; inspect typed evidence, scope and source locators.
Load complete robot packets, including sibling claim fields and limitations.
Open the referenced image bytes with image-capable tools; text captions do not confer visual understanding.
Check exact version, mechanism interfaces, performance conditions and rule applicability.
Recommend a coherent architecture, alternatives, unresolved issues and a decision-changing test.

generation.inputs: Included data JSONL, embedded game chapters, Markdown docs and original image bytes
